investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GETs (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's own official homepage and its own monthly programme page (a real, dedicated per-month URL pattern discovered from the homepage's own navigation, /sep-2026/). No JSON-LD, ICS, or JSON API was found — the site is a Jimdo (WYSIWYG website builder) page — but the September programme page's own retained HTML exposes a genuine, structurally repeatable per-event grid (date/time/genre cell, image cell, title/artist/price cell, all siblings inside one shared 'cc-matrix' row container per event) with real upcoming events.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://www.wabe-berlin.info/ returned a Jimdo-built static site (meta name="generator" content="Jimdo Creator") whose own navigation links to dedicated monthly programme pages (/aug-2026/, /sep-2026/, /okt-2026/, /nov-2026/). Fetching /sep-2026/ directly (no login, no JS execution) returned real, static HTML containing a repeatable per-event structural pattern (weekday/day/month/time/genre in one grid cell, artwork in a second, title/performer/price in a third — all three siblings inside one shared 'cc-matrix' container per event) for 9 real upcoming September 2026 events, plus a page-level 'SEPTEMBER 2026' heading retained once near the top of the event grid. This directly answers the investigation question at Level 1 — no JSON-LD/ICS/API exists, but a genuine, structurally-provable static event list does, so no Level 2/3 escalation was needed.

venue_reference: WABE (municipal cultural/music venue, Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin, near Volkspark Friedrichshain — as of this investigation temporarily displaced to an interim venue at Schönfließer Straße 7 while its usual Danziger Straße 101 site is renovated, with some open-air events remaining at the adjoining Kulturinsel site)

identity.notes: wabe-berlin.info (also served/branded as www.wabe-berlin.de per the page's own <title> tags) is WABE's own first-party site, not a ticketing aggregator — corroborated during discovery by the district's own berlin.de cultural-institution page (berlin.de/kunst-und-kultur-pankow/einrichtungen/wabe/) linking the same domain as WABE's official presence.

site_classification.platform: Jimdo (hosted WYSIWYG website builder) — no JSON-LD, ICS, WordPress, or headless-CMS API of any kind; each month is one hand-built static page using Jimdo's own 'cc-matrix' grid-layout modules, not a semantic calendar markup.

title.notes: Each event's own title/performer text cell (e.g. 'DEFA Songbook / PASCAL VON WROBLEWSKY UND DAS LORA KOSTINA TRIO'), structurally a sibling column inside the same 'cc-matrix' grid row as that event's date/time cell — genuine DOM containment, not visual proximity.

derivation.rule: The page's own single retained 'SEPTEMBER 2026' heading (appearing once near the top of the event grid, before any event rows) states the month and year that governs every event row on this page; each event's own date cell states only the weekday and day number (e.g. 'Donnerstag' / '24') plus a redundant restatement of the month name with no year. Concatenating the heading's year+month with the event cell's own day number yields exactly one unambiguous date per event.

start_date.notes: Sampled event: 'Donnerstag 24 September, 20:00, DEFA Songbook'. No year appears anywhere within the individual event cell itself — only via the page-level heading, which this project's v1.2 deterministic-context provision explicitly covers (directly analogous to the policy's own 'heading states September 2026, card states 17' worked example). Each event row does separately restate its own month name (e.g. 'September') directly, redundant with (and cross-checkable against) the heading's month — but never the year, so the heading remains load-bearing for the year component of the derivation. Re-verified 2026-08-26T21:00Z: a fresh live fetch of /sep-2026/ returned byte-identical HTML to the originally retained ev-sep-programme fixture, and the same derivation now also has a genuine offline reproduction (see ev evidence item wabe-berlin-01-offline-proof / tests/wabe.test.mjs), which mechanically re-parses the retained fixture and reproduces 2026-09-24 deterministically from the same two inputs on every run.

time.notes: Each event's own date/time cell states a plain 24-hour local time (e.g. '20:00') directly alongside its weekday/day/month — no combination needed. No UTC offset/timezone is stated anywhere on the page — honestly FLOATING_LOCAL.

end.notes: No end time is stated for any sampled event.

venue_location.notes: Each event's own text block directly states its specific location (most September 2026 events: 'Schönfließer Straße 7 (Saal)', the interim venue during renovation; a minority of open-air events instead directly state 'Kulturinsel Danziger Str. 101'). This is genuinely stated per event, not inherited from a single global page footer — but it is honestly volatile right now: WABE's usual/canonical address (Danziger Straße 101/105) differs from the interim address most events are actually held at during the renovation period, which matters for correctly resolving this source's events against Band on the Map's own canonical Venue record for WABE. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-26T21:00Z (still the current situation, not changed): the homepage and every retained monthly programme page's own footer both directly and explicitly state, under the heading 'NEUE SPIELSTÄTTE' ('new venue/performance space'), the full current interim address 'Schönfließer Straße 7, 10439 Berlin' — this is this investigation's most explicit, unambiguous statement of WABE's CURRENT operating address. The homepage also directly states, in its own text, 'Die WABE ist seit dem 1. Februar 2026 wegen Sanierungsarbeiten geschlossen' ('WABE has been closed since 1 February 2026 for renovation work') and 'Wir sind nun in der Schönfließer Straße 7 für sie da!' ('We are now at Schönfließer Straße 7 for you!'), directly confirming the displacement is still current and ongoing, not resolved. The original/canonical Danziger Straße 101 address remains in occasional use only for specific open-air Kulturinsel events, exactly as originally found — nothing about this situation has changed since the original investigation.

source_record_id.notes: No stable id, slug, or permalink is exposed per event. Each event is one row within a single shared month-page; the only per-element ids visible are Jimdo's own internal CMS module ids (e.g. 'cc-m-10716706185'), which are implementation-internal editor handles, not documented or evidenced as stable public identifiers — treating one as a stable source_record_id would violate the stable-identifier rule. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-26T21:00Z: a majority (but not all) event rows carry an 'Infos'/'Infos auf der Website des TuD' call-to-action link — some resolve to a same-site path of the shape /sep-2026/{day}/, others to a bespoke slug (e.g. /sommerfest/, /open-mic/), others to a different organisation's own separate site (theateruntermdach-berlin.de) for co-produced events, and some rows carry no link at all. This is a genuine, retained, DIRECT_EVIDENCE observation (the hrefs are present verbatim in the retained monthly-page fixtures) — but it is deliberately NOT used as this field's source_record_id, and state stays honestly NOT_PRESENT rather than PROVEN, because: (1) it is not present on every row, so no uniform strategy can be built from it alone; (2) its stability across independent fetches over time was not empirically tested/retained in this investigation (only a single snapshot exists); (3) the day-based slug shape (/sep-2026/{day}/) is not proven collision-free if two events on this page ever share the same day and both happen to carry such a link (not observed in the retained samples, but not ruled out either). ALTERNATIVE IDENTITY STRATEGY (documented per policy's stable-identifier rule and this project's gate 6): the observation-adapter (ingestion/wabe/observation-adapter.mjs) instead derives source_record_id deterministically from this source's own already-PROVEN date + time + title fields (e.g. '2026-09-24-2000-defa-songbook') — reproducible and unique across every sampled fixture (verified offline, see wabe-berlin-01-offline-proof), but explicitly NOT a source-native stable identifier, and never claimed as PROVEN at the investigation level.

event_url.notes: No event has its own dedicated page/URL on this source. Some co-produced events link out to 'Infos auf der Website des TuD' (Theater unterm Dach's own separate site), which is a different organisation's page, not WABE's own event_url.

price.notes: Each event's own price cell is directly stated, structurally a sibling of its title cell inside the same grid row. Prices are unstructured free text with multiple tiers (door price vs. reduced vs. online-presale) rather than one canonical number — genuinely present, but would need further text parsing by any real collector. A minority of events instead directly state 'Eintritt frei' (free entry).

blockers.description: The site is a hand-built Jimdo WYSIWYG page, not semantic calendar markup — extraction would rely on the page's own repeated 'cc-matrix' grid-row DOM pattern rather than any documented API/schema, making the parser more fragile to a future editorial re-layout than a JSON-LD/ICS/API-based source would be.

The venue is currently displaced to an interim address during renovation (a minority of events remain at the original Kulturinsel address) — any collector/observation-adapter would need to resolve which physical Venue record each event's stated location actually corresponds to, rather than assuming a single fixed WABE address for every event on the page.

RE-VERIFICATION (2026-08-26T21:00Z, follow-up task): a fresh plain curl GET of the live source confirmed the September 2026 page is byte-identical to the originally retained ev-sep-programme fixture, and confirmed the interim-venue/renovation situation is unchanged and still current (WABE closed since 1 Feb 2026 for renovation, operating from the interim 'NEUE SPIELSTÄTTE' at Schönfließer Straße 7, 10439 Berlin, per the homepage's own and every monthly page's own footer text) — nothing material has changed since the original investigation.

Two further genuinely-populated future month pages (October and November 2026) were newly retained and harvested alongside the original September page and the current (August 2026) page, for 19 real event rows total across all 4 currently-discoverable, currently-populated monthly programme pages (no December 2026 page is linked from the site's own navigation yet, so it is not a currently-discoverable data path).

A real, dependency-free, no-network offline observation-adapter (ingestion/wabe/observation-adapter.mjs) and test suite (tests/wabe.test.mjs) were built and run against all 4 retained fixtures, reproducing every claimed field (including the start_date DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT derivation) deterministically and offline — see evidence item wabe-berlin-01-offline-proof. This satisfies gate 9 and its v1.2 refinement for the start_date field's DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT basis.
